genomes.name: Combo: Recent Winners
genomes.thesis: The five setups that have worked over the last six months, in one book; first match wins, five 20% slots.
genomes.rationale: Built after the six-month re-ranking from the five setups that led it, so its six-month row is in-sample by construction; judge it on the twelve-month row and the 2010-2026 Nasdaq record.

genomes.name: Band Break on Volume
genomes.thesis: A close under the lower Bollinger band on 1.2x volume, any regime.
genomes.rationale: Second over the last six and twelve months on your names; loses over 2010-2022, so a recent-regime pick, not a durable one.

genomes.name: Volume Climax
genomes.thesis: Twice normal volume on a 3% down day, any regime: a flush that gets bought within two sessions.
genomes.rationale: Top of the last six months on your names and on the Nasdaq set; weak on the 2x single-stock pairs and flat in 2018-2020.

genomes.name: Red Day Near the Mean
genomes.thesis: A 4% down day within 3% of the 20-day mean on 1.2x volume.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.04 and close > sma20 * 0.97 and volume_ratio > 1.2

genomes.rationale: Profitable over the last six and twelve months on your names and on the Nasdaq set, and on the long Nasdaq history; loses on the single-stock pairs.

genomes.name: Two Red Days (evolved)
genomes.thesis: Yesterday down more than 2.8%, today down again, five-day loss beyond 7.8%, close still above the 50-day mean.
genomes.rationale: Positive on every window including the last six months; few trades, so treat each number as a small sample.

entry_rules.when: (ret1 < 0 and prev(ret1) < -0.028 and close > sma50) and ret5 < -0.078

genomes.name: Pullback Cluster
genomes.thesis: Two red closes and a 3% loss over five sessions, above the 50-day mean; out at the first close up 1% or after three bars, 10% stop. No volume gate: this is the original version, not the volume-gated one in the durable set.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < 0 and prev(ret1) < 0 and ret5 < -0.03 and close > sma50

genomes.rationale: Positive over the last six and twelve months on your names and the Nasdaq set; loses over 2010-2022 without the volume gate, so a recent-regime pick.

genomes.name: Squeeze Days (evolved)
genomes.thesis: Volatility contraction followed by a close above the upper band; ride the release for two sessions. Combined with: Two consecutive down days inside a rising 50-day trend: buy the second, sell the first green close.

entry_rules.when: (ret1 < 0 and prev(ret1) < -0.028 and close > sma50) and ret5 < -0.078

genomes.rationale: Evolved on the mega-cap pairs; positive over the last six and twelve months on all three universes.

genomes.name: Combo: All Five Setups
genomes.thesis: Every setup above in one agent, first match wins, five 20% slots. The most active book and the broadest evidence base.
genomes.rationale: The broad book from the long-history set; positive over the last six months on your names but flat on the Nasdaq set.
